root_cause.mechanism: PR_SET_PDEATHSIG was tied to the spawning OS thread. The Codex worker exited after approximately 10 idle seconds while the Codex process remained alive, terminating the MCP service.
root_cause.shutdown_gap: A non-daemon worker blocked in sys.stdin.readline survived cancellation and held the MCP stdout pipe open; the client did not receive EOF or a result.
root_cause.original_test_gap: Python MCP calls and Codex discovery/startup failure were tested separately; long commands through the real Codex MCP client were not covered.

fix.parent_lifetime: pidfd monitors the parent process; thread retirement does not cancel work.
fix.stdio: Async pipe reading leaves no blocking stdin worker after cancellation.
fix.diagnostics: Cancellation records now distinguish parent_exit, stdio_eof, signals and request cancellation.
